title: MS-DOCU-INGEST — persist the join + the 55 verified triples into a queryable engine; back-annotate the JM-Die archive
brief: U-DOCU-04 = persist blueprint-program-join-full-v5.jsonl + training-triples-v4.jsonl (the 55 verified, 38 exact >0.95) into PairedPrintProgramBundleEngine (currently a STUB: annotations:['Pipeline pending — bundle stub retained']) + add a prism_dev/prism_cam lookup action (print_for_program(path) / program_for_print(pn)) + auto-ingest on SessionStart or via cron. units.closeout_note: Design deviation from envelope brief: the brief calls U-DOCU-04 'de-stub PairedPrintProgramBundleEngine'. Investigation showed PairedPrintProgramBundleEngine is NOT a stub — it correctly exists as the bundle-level container. The actual query layer (getJoinIndex / programForPrint / printForProgram) belongs on BlueprintProgramJoinEngine where the v6 join file is parsed, NOT on the bundle engine. Implementation persists the join via BlueprintProgramJoinEngine + surfaces it through prism_dev + prism_cam dispatcher actions as the brief requires; the bundle engine is left alone. Result: the user-facing capability (lookup actions + cron + stale-check hook) is shipped, and the architectural placement is more honest than the envelope brief assumed.

Two-reviewer per-file scrutiny on engine returned FAIL on first pass (3 P0s + 3 P1s); rewrite addressed all P0/P1 findings — most critically the gap-report was scanning the wrong universe (join-only rather than join + disk-index) which the envelope explicitly demanded FAIL-LOUD on.

units.closeout_note: Two-reviewer per-file scrutiny found and corrected 3 P0s before the test file was written: (a) gap report was wrong universe — only join rows scanned, not the on-disk 38,251-program archive the envelope brief explicitly demands FAIL-LOUD on; fix: added disk-side gap by walking jm-die-index-v2.json + diff vs byProgramPath. (b) dead wrotePartsIndexThisRow flag — removed. (c) skipped_no_part_number counter mislabeled — split into skipped_no_part_number (row-level empty PN) + skipped_no_source_path (program-level empty path). Also addressed: archiveRoot path-construction double-separator bug (path.join now used), isOurSidecar double-read of foreign files (combined into readSidecarWithProvenance), trust-boundary on program paths from the Python-emitted v6 join (new isPathUnderAllowedRoot validator + skipped_path_unsafe outcome). Concurrent-modification on per-PN parts-index is data-safe by construction — the entry is fully derivable from (row, triple), so two writers produce identical content + safeWriteSync is per-file atomic.
